ownership.quote: Green Mini host BV • Founded in 2009

stage.quote: Green Mini host started with a single Mac mini server in a shared rack... Green Mini host grew quickly to become the largest provider of Mac mini hosting in Europe.
stage.note: Dutch private company (BV) founded in 2009 with no mention of any external funding, VC investors, or accelerator program anywhere on its site or in public search results; no funding-related press coverage found. Treated as bootstrapped/self-funded rather than 'unknown' given the 16-year organic-growth narrative, but no explicit statement of profitability or investor absence was found.

note: Green Mini host BV is a specialised Mac-mini/Mac-hosting provider based in Amsterdam, founded in 2009, describing itself as '100% European owned' and operating its own data centers/network in the Netherlands (Tier 3+, ISO 27001/9001). Company presents itself as an established, organically-grown hosting business (customers 'ranging from small businesses to enterprise customers with hundreds of servers') rather than a VC-backed startup; no funding rounds, accelerator participation, or investor names were found in company materials or web search. LinkedIn and DuckDuckGo search were blocked/unreachable during research (HTTP 999 / no results), limiting corroboration; findings rely on the company's own site.
